body: apps/arena's client only supported --connect host:port (an already-known server), useless against the persistent bot pool where the matchmaker assigns a new port per match. Added --queue <matchmaker_host>/--matchmaker-port, reusing apps/arena_bot's exact PACKET_FIND_MATCH/MATCH_FOUND queue pattern and net_connect's existing ticket handshake -- pure client-side, no server changes. Verified live: real matchmaker + one persistent bot, human client queued, matched with the bot, connected, assigned hero slot 1 on the same server the bot connected to (slot 0). First attempt failed on a test-setup mistake (matchmaker shell missing REDGARDEN_TICKET_SECRET, server correctly failed closed) not a code bug. Still bounded by the pre-existing no-Xvfb gap -- join proven, playing a full match still needs a real display. Commit b7bcc9d.
title: Human player can join the persistent bot pool (S170-44)
